learning_outcomes.text: Have sufficient basic knowledge of control systems.
Has ability to define the types of dynamic systems and their parameters.
Has abilitiy to define mathematical models of systems.

syllabus_topics: Mathematical modelling and system dynamics. Linear and nonlinear systems. Transfer functions. First order systems.
Basic system components. Electric, mechanic, fluid and thermal system components.
Block diagrams. Rules of block diagram reduction. Disturbance inputs.
Modelling and analysing of dynamic systems. Detailed analysis of electric, mechanic, fluid and thermal systems. Obtaining transfer functions.
Mixed systems. Electro-mechanic, electro-fluid, pneumatic, electric-pneumatic systems.
Fluid power systems. Electro-hydraulic systems. State variable models.
Steady-state error and characterization of systems. Errors and error coefficients.
bibliography: Otomatik Kontrol Sistem Dinamiği ve Denetim Sistemleri, İbrahim YÜKSEL, Nobel Yayın Dağıtım
